Description: Review only: 12 ingress resources. No runtime, WABA association or sends. IAM metadata patch prerequisite.
TemplateBody:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Screen Art encrypted WhatsApp demo ingress only; no runtime, sends or Core deployment
Parameters:
  KmsAdministratorArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-stage-cfn-execution
    Description: Existing stable IAM CloudFormation service role. Also select this role in stack Permissions. Do
      not use AWSReservedSSO roles.
  KmsRecoveryAdministratorArn:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
    - arn:aws:iam::365470560685:role/muserelay-aws-bridge-kms-recovery
    Description: Existing stable IAM recovery role from separately authorized IAM foundation; retain while the KMS
      key exists.
Rules:
  ScreenArtDemo:
    Assertions:
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::AccountId
        - '365470560685'
      AssertDescription: Screen Art account only.
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::Region
        - eu-west-1
      AssertDescription: Ireland only.
    - Assert:
        Fn::Equals:
        - Ref: AWS::StackName
        - muserelay-aws-bridge-stage
      AssertDescription: Use the reviewed stack name to preserve the SNS topic and queue identities.
Resources:
  SnsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Screen Art MuseRelay staging SNS events; dedicated hackathon key
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: false
      PendingWindowInDays: 7
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: DedicatedKeyAdministration
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Ref: KmsAdministratorArn
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          - kms:EnableKey
          - kms:EnableKeyRotation
          - kms:DisableKeyRotation
          - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
          - kms:ListResourceTags
          - kms:TagResource
          - kms:UntagResource
          - kms:UpdateKeyDescription
          - kms:CreateAlias
          - kms:UpdateAlias
          - kms:DeleteAlias
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: DedicatedRecoveryAdministrator
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Ref: KmsRecoveryAdministratorArn
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: AccountPolicyRecovery
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS:
              Fn::Sub: arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
          Action:
          - kms:DescribeKey
          - kms:GetKeyPolicy
          - kms:PutKeyPolicy
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: AllowScreenArtSocialPublishEncryption
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: social-messaging.amazonaws.com
          Action:
          - kms:GenerateDataKey*
          - kms:Decrypt
          Resource: '*'
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
            ArnLike:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:social-messaging:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
      BypassPolicyLockoutSafetyCheck: false
  SnsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName:
        Fn::Sub: alias/${AWS::StackName}-sns
      TargetKeyId:
        Ref: SnsKey
  InboundTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound
      FifoTopic: false
      KmsMasterKeyId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
        - SnsKey
        - Arn
      MaximumMessageSize: 262144
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  TopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
      - Ref: InboundTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: social-messaging.amazonaws.com
          Action: sns:Publish
          Resource:
            Ref: InboundTopic
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
            ArnLike:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Fn::Sub: arn:aws:social-messaging:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
  InboundDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound-dlq
      RedriveAllowPolicy:
        redrivePermission: byQueue
        sourceQueueArns:
        - Fn::Sub: arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${AWS::StackName}-inbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  InboundQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      VisibilityTimeout: 180
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn:
          Fn::GetAtt:
          - InboundDlq
          - Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-inbound-queue
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  InboundQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
      - Ref: InboundQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: sns.amazonaws.com
          Action: sqs:SendMessage
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt:
            - InboundQueue
            - Arn
          Condition:
            ArnEquals:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Ref: InboundTopic
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
  DeliveryDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-sns-delivery-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  DeliveryDlqPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
      - Ref: DeliveryDlq
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: sns.amazonaws.com
          Action: sqs:SendMessage
          Resource:
            Fn::GetAtt:
            - DeliveryDlq
            - Arn
          Condition:
            ArnEquals:
              aws:SourceArn:
                Ref: InboundTopic
            StringEquals:
              aws:SourceAccount:
                Ref: AWS::AccountId
  Subscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    DependsOn:
    - InboundQueuePolicy
    - DeliveryDlqPolicy
    - TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      TopicArn:
        Ref: InboundTopic
      Protocol: sqs
      Endpoint:
        Fn::GetAtt:
        - InboundQueue
        - Arn
      RawMessageDelivery: false
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn:
          Fn::GetAtt:
          - DeliveryDlq
          - Arn
  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName:
        Fn::Sub: ${AWS::StackName}-artifacts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
        - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
        - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
        - Id: ExpireDemoArtifacts
          Status: Enabled
          ExpirationInDays: 30
          AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
            DaysAfterInitiation: 1
      Tags:
      - Key: Company
        Value: ScreenArt
      - Key: Project
        Value: MuseRelay
      - Key: Component
        Value: aws-engagement-bridge
      - Key: Environment
        Value: staging
      - Key: Purpose
        Value: hackathon
  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket:
        Ref: ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: RequireTls
          Effect: Deny
          Principal: '*'
          Action: s3:*
          Resource:
          - Fn::GetAtt:
            - ArtifactBucket
            - Arn
          - Fn::Sub: ${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*
          Condition:
            Bool:
              aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
              aws:PrincipalIsAWSService: 'false'
Outputs:
  InboundTopicArn:
    Value:
      Ref: InboundTopic
  SnsKeyArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - SnsKey
      - Arn
  InboundQueueArn:
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
      - InboundQueue
      - Arn
  InboundQueueUrl:
    Value:
      Ref: InboundQueue
  InboundDeadLetterQueue:
    Value:
      Ref: InboundDlq
  SnsDeliveryDeadLetterQueue:
    Value:
      Ref: DeliveryDlq
  SubscriptionArn:
    Value:
      Ref: Subscription
  ArtifactBucketName:
    Value:
      Ref: ArtifactBucket
